IN CASE YOU MISSED IT: Natalana nga power interruption bwas nga adlaw, SEPTEMBER 20, 2026 (Sunday).
Yari ang detalye sang power advisory.

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 20, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 20, 2026 (Sunday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 20, 2026 (Sunday)
Reason: 
● Reconductoring of 1.0 km 2/0 bare wire 3Ph Primary line MF2 along La Salle; and
● Reconductoring of 0.3km #2 bare wire 3-phase prim. Line BF5 along CL Montelibano.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 7:00AM &  5:00PM to 6:00PM
Portion of MF2 - Portion of USLS, La Salle Avenue (Rollis to BS  Aquino), Lacson St. (12th and 13th St.), Triangle Plaza, NORD Medical Hub, Medical Plaza, The Doctor’s Hospital.
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of MF2 - San Lorenzo Ruiz, Prk. Canaan, Santorini, Purok Yanson, Tierra Minerva, Eroreco subd, Prk Casiana, Prk Sulom 1,St.  Scholastica Academy, La Salle Avenue (La Salle to St. Scho), Capitol  Ville, Portion of USLS.
Portion of BF5 - CL Montelibano-6th St. Going Lasalle.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
